sources.title: Piracy monthly report January 2025
sources.text: While underway, four perpetrators armed with a gun were sighted in the engine room. The master raised the alarm and mustered crew to conduct a search onboard, but with no sighting of the perpetrators. Nothing was stolen. All crew members were accounted for, and no injury to the crew was reported. The master reported the incident to Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS) West. A safety navigational broadcast was initiated. The Republic of Singapore Navy (RSN)’s Maritime Security Task Force (MSTF) and Singapore Police Coast Guard (PCG) were notified of the incident. The PCG boarded the ship upon her arrival at Singapore, conducted a search, and no perpetrators were found onboard. Information of the incident was shared with the Indonesian authorities.
